    Rank under specialization of a matrix #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_matrix_rank_factorization {k : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} [Field k] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n k) :
    ∃ (B : Matrix m (Fin A.rank) k) (C : Matrix (Fin A.rank) n k) (L : Matrix (Fin A.rank) m k) (R : Matrix n (Fin A.rank) k), B * C = A ∧ L * B = 1 ∧ C * R = 1

    A rectangular matrix over a field factors through a space of dimension its rank. The two factors admit a left inverse and a right inverse respectively.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.matrix_rank_map_from_field {k : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} {n : Type u_4} [Field k] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (e : k →+* S) (A : Matrix m n k) :
    (A.map ⇑e).rank = A.rank

    A matrix with coefficients in a field has the same rank after embedding the coefficients in a commutative domain.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.matrix_rank_specialization_le_of_injective {k : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} {m : Type u_4} {n : Type u_5} [Field k] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (e : S →+* k) (c : k →+* S) (h : e.comp c = RingHom.id k) (f : S →+* T) (hf : Function.Injective ⇑f) (A : Matrix m n S) :
    (A.map ⇑e).rank ≤ (A.map ⇑f).rank

    The rank after specialization is bounded by the rank in any domain into which the coefficient ring embeds.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.matrix_rank_specialization_le {k : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} {n : Type u_4} [Field k] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (e : S →+* k) (c : k →+* S) (h : e.comp c = RingHom.id k) (A : Matrix m n S) :
    (A.map ⇑e).rank ≤ A.rank

    Specialization of the coefficients to a field cannot increase rank.
